Note::indent¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

Note Note::indent() const

Add A Fixed Indent To Every Line¶

indent() returns a new Note, same shape as the input, with two spaces prepended to the first line of each cell and to every line that follows a \n. Use it to nest a block under a heading, quote a snippet, or format multi-line content for a list or log entry.

Lines are split on \n. Every line gets the indent, including a trailing empty line after a final \n. Nothing else in the cell is changed.

indent is the inverse of dedent for a block that had a uniform two-space indent. It is shape-preserving, cell-independent, and returns a fresh Note.

Example 1: A Batch¶

std::cout << pluss::note::print(
    pluss::make_note({"line1\nline2", "solo"}).indent())
    << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[2], dim=1, numel=2, encoding=utf8)
["  line1\n  line2", "  solo"]

See Also¶

  • Note::dedent: the inverse — strip the common leading indent.

  • Note::ensure_prefix: add a prefix to the whole cell once, not per line.

  • Note::surround: wrap the whole cell in a prefix/suffix pair.
